title: He Outgrew His Puppy Crate… But Not the Memories 🐶💔
description:
He has a bigger bed now. Softer. More comfortable.
But every night, he still squeezes into the tiny crate he used as a puppy.

Even though he barely fits…
That little space still feels like home.

Because sometimes, it’s not about comfort —
it’s about where you first felt safe. 🐾
